title.zh-TW: 系統提示詞支援即時重算，調校文案免重啟對話
title.en: Real-Time System Prompt Re-Rendering Without Restarting Conversations

body.zh-TW: 正在反覆微調提示詞（prompt）卻苦於每次改動都得開新對話，新的 `--system-prompt-snapshot off` 旗標正是為此而生。當你在打磨自訂提示詞內容時，系統預設會沿用工作階段初次錄製的提示詞快照，導致你在外側修改了檔案文字，當前的對話依然讀取舊版內容。現在只要在啟動 Claude 時帶上這個選項，每一次發出提問都會重新讀取並渲染最新的系統提示詞，讓文案調校的測試過程變得更加靈活迅速。⟦整套流程好似在排練室試穿戲服，每次出場都當場換上最新修改的布料剪裁，不必每修一針就得解散劇組重新開演。⟧
body.en: If you are iterating on prompt text and tired of starting a new conversation for every tweak, the new `--system-prompt-snapshot off` flag is built for you. When polishing custom prompt content, the system by default reuses the prompt snapshot recorded at session start, causing active conversations to keep reading stale content even after you edit external files. Now, by passing this flag when launching Claude, every request will reload and render the latest system prompt fresh, making prompt experimentation much faster and more flexible. ⟦The entire workflow is like trying on costumes in a rehearsal hall: actors step onto the stage wearing the latest fabric adjustments on the spot, rather than dismissing the entire cast to restart the show after every stitch.⟧

title.zh-TW: 外部工具異動保全推論思考，切換模型快取不漏接
title.en: Reasoning Preserved Across Tool Changes, Cache Reuse Holds on Model Switches

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 呼叫外部工具或中途切換模型時，先前辛苦推導的思考脈絡不再無端消失。⟦這好比多位專家在會議室白板上記錄解題推導，中途就算外聘顧問進出或更換麥克風，也不會突然把整面黑板的心算擦掉重抄。⟧以往 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器重送模型已載入的工具、內建工具重繪，或工具因斷線升級而消失時，清單重寫往往會丟失先前的思考內容；如今推論皆能妥善保留。在未開啟工具搜尋的工作階段中，外掛動態加入也會改以延遲定義傳遞，避免破壞快取（把算過結果暫存起來直接用）複用。透過 `/model` 切換模型時不再重發全部工具定義；commit 與 PR 的歸屬文字改以對話附註送達，並會在切換模型時更新，且 claude.ai 連接器工具在工作階段更動時也能保住推論記憶。
body.en: When Claude invokes external tools or switches models mid-session, previously accumulated reasoning context no longer vanishes unexpectedly. ⟦This is like experts solving equations across a conference room whiteboard: even if guest consultants walk in and out or microphones get swapped, no one suddenly wipes the entire board clean to start over.⟧ Previously, when an MCP server re-sent definitions, a built-in tool re-rendered, or a tool disappeared due to disconnections or upgrades, rewriting the tool list discarded earlier thinking; reasoning is now safely preserved. In sessions without ToolSearch, dynamically added plugin tools are now passed as deferred definitions to prevent breaking prompt-cache reuse. Switching models via `/model` no longer re-sends every tool definition; commit and PR attribution text now arrives as a conversation note that updates on model changes, and reasoning memory is also retained when claude.ai connector tools change across session resumes.

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段沿用工具描述，背景任務不破壞提示快取
title.en: Resumed Sessions Reuse Tool Descriptions, Background Tasks Preserve Prompt Cache

body.zh-TW: 重新打開先前未完成的工作階段時，最怕背景暫存全部失效導致推論延遲。以前從對話分岔出的背景工作單元若把 `EnterWorktree` 這個工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）工具加進對話的工具清單，便會破壞快取重用機制。現在恢復工作階段時，不會再因 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）重連時間差而改寫工具清單或丟失思考，首回合執行工具時也能直接重播既有描述而非重新渲染。此外，從 `-p` 印出模式切換至互動模式時系統提示詞前綴保持一致。透過 `--system-prompt` 或 `--append-system-prompt` 啟動的子代理與工作階段，也會一次記錄提示詞與工具定義，不再每次重新渲染。⟦延續同一個會議記錄思維，這就像隔天回到會議室復工時，直接對照昨天蓋印封存的會議底稿接續討論，不會因為助手分頭跑腿或翻開備份記錄就擅自撕掉前言。⟧
body.en: When reopening unfinished sessions, cache invalidation causing inference delays is a major pain point. Previously, when a background worker forked from a conversation added `EnterWorktree` to the conversation's tool block, it broke prompt-cache reuse. Now when resuming a session, tool lists are no longer rewritten and thinking is no longer dropped due to MCP reconnection timing differences; turns executing tools on the first step also replay recorded descriptions directly instead of re-rendering them. Additionally, the system prompt prefix remains consistent when resuming a print-mode (`-p`) conversation interactively. Subagents and sessions launched with `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` now record prompt and tool definitions once instead of re-rendering them. ⟦Continuing the meeting records analogy, this is like resuming work in the conference room the next day with yesterday's stamped and sealed minutes, without tearing off the preface just because assistants ran errands or opened backup logs.⟧

title.zh-TW: 工件發布支援斷線自動重試，明確指出損壞字元行數與欄位
title.en: Artifact Publishing Adds Auto-Retry on Disconnects, Pinpoints Corrupted Character Locations

body.zh-TW: 發布工件（artifact，在獨立視窗展示的成果文件）若中途網路斷線或遇到格式錯誤，現在不再只回傳不明原因的失敗代碼。在過去，如果上傳檔案時連線中斷，Claude Code 往往只能回報未知結果；如今只要判定傳輸未完成，就會自動重試 1 次以確保順利送達。當頁面檔案並非有效的 UTF-8 編碼，或是包含代表損毀的替換字元（U+FFFD）時，錯誤訊息也不再模糊帶過，而是會具體標示出需要修正的行數與欄位。若工件發布遭到拒絕，畫面亦會清楚解釋被拒原因以及具體的應對處置方法。⟦這套防護有如印刷廠送件作業，遇到斷線能自動重發一次，內容包含損壞字元時會明確指出第幾行第幾列，被拒絕出版時也會清楚說明退件原因與修改方針。⟧
body.en: When publishing artifacts, network drops or formatting errors no longer return vague failure codes. Previously, if a connection was cut off mid-upload, Claude Code often reported an unknown outcome; now, whenever it detects that an upload never completed, it automatically retries 1 time to ensure delivery. When a page file is not valid UTF-8 or contains replacement characters (U+FFFD) indicating corruption, error messages no longer gloss over the issue, instead explicitly naming the line and column to fix. If an artifact publish is refused, the screen also clearly explains the reason along with actionable remediation steps. ⟦This protection is like submitting print jobs to a press: it automatically retries once if transmission drops, pinpoints exact row and column numbers if corrupted characters appear, and provides clear rejection reasons and revision instructions if publishing is turned down.⟧

Fixed artifact publish failing with an unhelpful error when the page file isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a replacement character (U+FFFD); the error now names the line and column to fix
Improved Artifact tool publish errors: when a publish is refused, the message now says why and what to do about it

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控憑證過期自動續期，及時同步桌面與編輯器權限
title.en: Automatic Renewal for Expired Remote Control Credentials, Real-Time Desktop and Editor Permission Sync

body.zh-TW: 在遠端電腦透過 `claude remote-control` 連線工作時，長時間掛機最怕憑證失效讓所有連線瞬間中斷。⟦這如同在長效監控哨所配置專用通信機，遇到月度密碼過期會自行向總部換約重連而不斷線，新加入的聯絡終端也能即時掌握目前的防衛等級。⟧以往遠端伺服器憑證在大約 30 天過期後，主機行程會直接退出並切斷所有掛載的工作階段；現在主機端會自動重新註冊憑證並持續保持運作。同時，新加入 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 工作階段的遠端操控客戶端，之前常停留在過期的舊權限模式直到手動變更，如今一連上就能立刻呈現即時且正確的權限狀態。
body.en: When working on a remote machine via `claude remote-control`, long-running sessions no longer suffer sudden drops from expired credentials. ⟦This is like equipping an outpost with a dedicated communicator that automatically renews its monthly passcode with headquarters without dropping the link, while newly connected terminals instantly reflect current defense levels.⟧ Previously, when server credentials expired after about 30 days, the host process exited and dropped all attached sessions; now the host automatically re-registers and keeps running. Meanwhile, Remote Control clients joining a Claude Desktop or VS Code session previously remained on stale permission modes until changed manually, but now immediately reflect accurate, up-to-date permission states upon connecting.

title.zh-TW: 企業受管設定嚴密把關，雲端憑證逾期精確回報
title.en: Strict Enterprise Managed Settings Enforcement, Accurate Cloud Credential Expiration Reporting

body.zh-TW: 在由公司統一控管規則的企業環境中，雲端排程與登入驗證具備更嚴密的防護。受管設定要求沙箱時 Cowork 雲端排程啟動失敗已修復；`allowedHttpHookUrls`、`httpHookAllowedEnvVars` 與 `allowedChannelPlugins` 讀取失敗時一律不予放行。在 Claude Desktop 下 AWS 或 Google Cloud 憑證過期不再盲目重試 10 次，改為提示重新認證；強制閘道登入框按 Esc 即可關閉。自建執行端會回報 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 並對使用舊代理的工作階段提出警示，轉發身分遇 429 限制不再轉移上游以落實每人配額。⟦整體防護宛若金融大樓的安全閘道，條文讀取不清時一律從嚴封鎖，身分過期不再盲目空轉十次，限制也確實落實到每位個別訪客頭上。⟧
body.en: In enterprise environments governed by centralized policies, cloud scheduling and login authentication now receive tighter safeguards. Startup failures for Cowork cloud scheduled tasks in organizations requiring sandboxing are now fixed; unreadable `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars`, and `allowedChannelPlugins` settings now admit nothing rather than everything. Under Claude Desktop, expired AWS or Google Cloud credentials no longer blindly retry 10 times, prompting for re-authentication instead; pressing Esc now closes the mandatory gateway login dialog. Self-hosted runners now report `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` and warn sessions cloning via the legacy proxy, while `forward_user_identity` passes 429 rate limits directly to developers rather than failing over upstreams to enforce per-user quotas. ⟦The overall defense resembles security turnstiles in a financial building: unreadable rules strictly deny entry, expired badges no longer trigger ten pointless retry spins, and limits are enforced on every individual visitor.⟧

title.zh-TW: 終端機按鍵與滾動修復，輸入文字不再延遲跳格
title.en: Terminal Keystroke and Scrolling Fixes, Jitter-Free Responsive Text Input

body.zh-TW: 在手機或終端機全螢幕下操作各項指令，文字輸入與介面捲動現在更加乾淨俐落。⟦這恰似把老舊放映機的齒輪重新校準，打字輸入不再因為背景動畫轉動而延遲跳格，切換視窗或滑動閱覽時畫面資訊也穩定呈現。⟧以前在代理人檢視中重新連線至 tmux 或 ssh 工作階段後，Shift+Enter 換行與 Option+Backspace 刪除單詞等快捷鍵會失效，如今已完全修復。行動端設備執行 `/context` 等本機指令時輸出空白的問題已獲解決，在全螢幕向上滾動時，對話頂端也能正常顯示淡色的上一則提問提示。此外，`/diff` 程式碼差異面板不再先閃爍零個檔案變更與載入轉圈才定格，無改動時的空白提示也已置中對齊，打字時按鍵更不會被載入動畫卡住延遲。
body.en: Operating commands across mobile clients or fullscreen terminals is now much smoother for text input and interface scrolling. ⟦This is like recalibrating the gears of a classic projector: typing input no longer lags behind background animations, and screen details remain steady when switching windows or scrolling.⟧ Previously inside agent views, reconnecting to tmux or ssh sessions broke shortcuts like Shift+Enter for newlines and Option+Backspace for word deletion; these are now fully fixed. Blank outputs when running local commands like `/context` on mobile devices have been resolved, and scrolling up in fullscreen mode now reliably shows the dim last-prompt header at the top. Additionally, the `/diff` code difference panel no longer flashes "0 files changed" with a spinner before settling, its empty state is centered, and keystrokes are no longer delayed by loading animations.

title.zh-TW: 恢復大容量歷史對話不掉內容，用量警示燈號穩定顯示
title.en: Restoring Large Conversation Transcripts Without Data Loss, Stable Usage Warnings

body.zh-TW: 恢復先前對話或載入超過 5 MB 的超大歷史紀錄時，整個還原過程變得更乾淨迅速。以前在包含大量 Bash 工具呼叫的對話中執行 `--resume`，首次渲染畫面常需等待；現在首次渲染更快。當工作階段的對話紀錄超過 5 MB 時，先前重新載入對話容易漏失平行工具呼叫與掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）輸出，如今資料都能完整重現。透過 `-p --resume` 執行 `/compact` 壓縮或其他斜線指令後，對話中也不會再多生出一筆多餘的接續提示。如果工作階段中因切換不同模型或模式而回傳不同的額度週期，用量上限警示也不會再忽明忽暗地閃爍。⟦整個載入流程好比翻開厚重的歷史卷宗，即使檔案超過 5 MB 且包含多條平行批註也能完整讀取，恢復作業時不再無故多插一張空白備忘頁。⟧
body.en: Resuming previous conversations and loading massive transcripts over 5 MB is now cleaner and faster. Previously, running `--resume` on sessions with many Bash tool calls caused noticeable delays on first render; first-render time is now shorter. When a session transcript exceeds 5 MB, reloading used to drop parallel tool calls and their hook output; all of it now comes back intact. If switching models or modes within a session returns varying quota windows, usage-limit warnings no longer flicker on and off. ⟦The entire loading process is like opening a heavy historical archive: even files exceeding 5 MB with parallel marginal notes load completely, without inserting an unneeded blank memo page upon resumption.⟧

items.original:
Fixed resuming a session after `/compact` or another slash command ran via `-p --resume`: a spurious "Continue from where you left off." turn is no longer inserted

Fixed the usage-limit warning flickering on and off during a session when requests for different models or modes report different limit windows

title.zh-TW: 終端指令回傳白話說明，市集路徑防護與沙箱複製指引
title.en: Plain-Language Terminal Command Descriptions, Marketplace Path Containment and Sandbox Copy Guidance

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 在自動模式或沙箱環境執行工作時，工具的引導說明與安全把關變得更親切嚴謹。以往執行終端命令時，Claude 常只是機械式複誦指令；現在更新了 Bash 工具說明指引，引導它用大白話解釋命令的作用。在沙箱內若遇到 `pbcopy` 等剪貼簿指令執行失敗，Claude 會主動建議改用內建的 `/copy` 指令。工作流程中帶有龐大輸出結構的 `agent()` 呼叫，在自動模式下不再直接被拒，而是交由安全分類器審查。在 macOS 與 Linux 上，外掛市集路徑帶有反斜線可繞過邊界檢查的漏洞已堵死；`claude agents` 的 `@` 選單也能即時列出工作階段開啟後新建立的儲存庫。⟦這如同給領航員換上更清晰的作業指南，執行指令時會用白話解釋步驟，遇到封閉環境複製失敗時也會主動推薦替代指令。⟧
body.en: When running Claude in auto mode or sandboxed environments, tool descriptions and security checks are now clearer and stricter. Previously when executing terminal commands, Claude often mechanically echoed the command; updated Bash tool guidance now steers it to explain what commands do in plain words. Inside the sandbox, if clipboard commands like `pbcopy` fail, Claude proactively suggests using the built-in `/copy` command. In workflows, `agent()` calls with large output schemas are no longer flatly refused in auto mode, routing to the safety classifier for review instead. On macOS and Linux, vulnerabilities where marketplace entry paths containing backslashes bypassed containment checks have been closed, and the `claude agents` `@` menu now lists repositories created after session start. ⟦This is like giving a navigator clearer operational guidelines: explaining steps in plain terms when issuing commands, and recommending alternative commands when copy operations fail inside closed quarters.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Workflow `agent()` calls with large output schemas being refused in auto mode instead of being checked by the safety classifier
Fixed a case where a marketplace entry path containing a backslash could bypass the containment check for fetched marketplaces on macOS and Linux
Fixed `claude agents` `@` directory menu not listing repositories created after the session started
Improved the Bash tool's description guidance so Claude describes what a command does in plain words instead of echoing the command
Improved sandbox guidance so Claude suggests `/copy` when clipboard commands such as `pbcopy` fail inside the sandbox

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 差異檢視跟隨編輯器主題，修復截圖貼上與多語系文字
title.en: [VSCode] Diff View Adapts to Editor Themes, Fixes for Screenshot Pasting and Multilingual Text

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡與 Claude 對話，程式碼差異對照面板現在能完美貼合你的編輯器主題。⟦體驗改善有如為繪圖板換上具備自動調色的多功能畫布，不管是貼上圖片、選用高對比深淺外觀，或是處理帶有空格的檔名，筆觸都精準無誤。⟧過去對話框中的變更區塊總是強制以深色佈景顯示，現在會同步套用當前啟用的色彩主題與高對比模式。在 WSL2 或 WSLg 環境下貼上螢幕截圖時，不再把原始圖片位元組塞進輸入框，而是直接轉成附件或自動略過；同時修復了混合由右至左語系與英文時文字順序錯亂的問題。在檔案修改方面，採 Windows（CRLF）換行格式的檔案在確認套用變更時不再噴出找不到字串的錯誤，且使用 `@` 提及檔案時也不會漏掉路徑帶有空格的檔案。
body.en: When chatting with Claude in VS Code, code diff panels now align with your active editor theme. ⟦The upgrade is like outfitting a graphics tablet with an auto-adjusting color canvas: whether pasting images, choosing high-contrast dark or light themes, or handling filenames with spaces, every stroke remains precise.⟧ Previously, chat diff blocks always rendered with a dark theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast. Pasting screenshots on WSL2 or WSLg no longer inserts raw bytes into the chat input, instead attaching the image or ignoring the paste if unavailable; typing mixed right-to-left and English text in the wrong order has also been fixed. For file edits, accepting changes in diff view on files with Windows (CRLF) line endings no longer fails with "String not found in file", and `@`-mentions no longer drop files with spaces in their paths.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed pasting a screenshot on WSL2/WSLg inserting raw image bytes into the chat input; the image is now attached when the clipboard provides it, otherwise the paste is ignored
[VSCode] Fixed chat diff blocks always rendering with a dark editor theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast
[VSCode] Fixed mixed right-to-left and English text rendering in the wrong order while typing in the message input
[VSCode] Fixed accepting an edit in the diff view on a file with Windows (CRLF) line endings failing with "String not found in file"
[VSCode] Fixed @-mentions dropping files whose paths contain spaces

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 遠端工作階段清單載入修復，排除循環歷史與行程空轉
title.en: [VSCode] Remote Session List Loading Fixes, Eliminating Cyclic Loops and Runaway Processes

body.zh-TW: 開啟含有大量捷徑或龐大專案的遠端主機時，VS Code 擴充套件不再因循環紀錄或檔案搜尋而把 CPU 衝上 100%。過去當對話存檔中包含循環的父層關聯時，進行對話分支、編輯歷史訊息或執行倒轉操作會導致外掛主機直接卡死在 100% CPU，現已修復。透過 Remote-SSH 連線且工作區資料夾僅存在於遠端電腦時，工作階段清單介面過去會載入失敗，目前已能正常顯示。此外，在超大型專案或含有密集符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）的工作環境中檢視檔案時，背景搜尋工具 ripgrep 行程失控狂飆的問題也獲得了解決。⟦承接同一個工作環境的平穩運作，這好似為巡檢機具加裝轉速調節器，遇到跨主機遠端連線或大量捷徑檔案時不再失控空轉。⟧
body.en: When connecting to remote hosts with symlink-heavy or massive codebases, the VS Code extension no longer spikes CPU to 100% over cyclic transcripts or file searches. Previously, when saved transcripts contained cyclic parent links, forking, editing earlier messages, or rewinding caused the extension host to hang at 100% CPU; this is now fixed. In windows connected over Remote-SSH where the workspace folder exists only on the remote host, the sessions list view previously failed to load and now renders properly. Additionally, runaway background ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces have been resolved. ⟦Continuing the smooth operation of this workspace, this is like adding a speed governor to inspection machinery, preventing uncontrolled spinning during cross-host remote connections or encounters with heavy shortcuts.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the extension host hanging at 100% CPU when forking, editing an earlier message, or rewinding in a conversation whose saved transcript contains a cyclic parent link
[VSCode] Fixed the sessions list view failing to load in windows connected over Remote-SSH when the workspace folder exists only on the remote host
[VSCode] Fixed runaway ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces

title.zh-TW: [Claude Code on the web] 企業版 GitHub 授權自動換新，調度本人帳號備援呼叫
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Automatic Token Refresh for GitHub Enterprise, Personal Account Fallback for API Calls

body.zh-TW: 透過網頁版 Claude Code 操作 GitHub 企業伺服器時，逾期的 token（授權令牌，用於身分認證）現在會自動換新。⟦這宛如在雲端工作台配置全天候秘書，遇到通行權杖逾期會自動換發，即使所屬單位未安裝官方擴充套件，也能直接採用你本人的帳號順暢銜接。⟧先前在 GitHub Enterprise Server 的工作階段中，只要個人認證憑證到期，介面就會誤標為帳號已斷線；如今在進行拉取請求（PR）或討論議題操作時，系統會自動在背景刷新授權並保持連線。另外，在尚未安裝 Claude GitHub App 的組織架構下，執行 `gh` 命令或呼叫 API 原先會直接報錯，現在會直接改用你已綁定的 GitHub 帳號發送請求，若尚未登入也會明確提示。
body.en: When working with GitHub Enterprise Server via Claude Code on the web, expired tokens now refresh automatically. ⟦This is like assigning a 24/7 assistant to your cloud workbench: when access tokens expire, they are renewed automatically, and operations seamlessly fall back to your personal account even if the organization lacks the official app.⟧ Previously in GitHub Enterprise Server sessions, expired authentication credentials caused the interface to report the GitHub account as disconnected; PR and issue operations now automatically refresh tokens in the background to stay connected. Additionally, in organizations without the Claude GitHub App installed, running `gh` commands or making GitHub API calls previously threw errors, but now routes through your connected GitHub account and explicitly notes when none is connected.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed GitHub Enterprise Server sessions showing your GitHub account as disconnected once its token expired; PR and issue operations now refresh it automatically
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls failing in organizations without the Claude GitHub App; they now use your connected GitHub account and say so when none is connected

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 預設連線支援切換自訂通道，額度耗盡清楚指引儲值

body.zh-TW: 負責管理 Claude Tag 團隊連線的管理者，現在不必刪除重來就能將預設通道切換至自訂連接器。在後台設定預設連線表單時，新加入的「Use a custom connector」連結允許你中途直接轉向自訂通道。當團隊組織的用量額度耗盡時，Claude 過去只會冰冷回報 API 拒絕了無效請求，現在會具體說明額度已用完並指引儲值方法。在頻道頂層發布訊息後，成員在討論串內要求編輯或刪除該則貼文時，指令不再被誤判為對話糾錯，而是確實轉交給當初發文的工作階段處理。此外，管理審查介面的工具存取授權請求點擊「Connect」時，之前常跳出授權失敗或誤報授權包已刪除的問題也已修正。⟦整個調整就像在團隊客服總機後台增加切換自訂外線的捷徑，額度用盡時明確告知儲值途徑，留言串內的修改請求也能準確遞交給當初發文的專員。⟧
body.en: Administrators managing Claude Tag team connections can now switch preset connections to custom connectors without starting over. When configuring preset connection forms in admin settings, a newly added "Use a custom connector" link lets you pivot directly to custom channels. When an organization runs out of usage credits, Claude previously replied with a generic message stating the API rejected an invalid request; it now explicitly explains credits are exhausted and details how to add more. After Claude posts a message at a channel's top level, thread requests to edit or delete that post are no longer treated as conversational corrections, routing properly to the session that originally posted it. Additionally, clicking **Connect** on Tool access requests under Admin settings > Review requests previously failed with "Authorization failed" or showed the access bundle as deleted; this has now been resolved. ⟦The overall update is like adding a shortcut to switch to custom outside lines in a team switchboard: clearly guiding top-ups when credit runs out and routing thread edit requests to the original dispatcher.⟧

items.original:

[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude replying "The API rejected the request as invalid" when the organization has run out of usage credits; the reply now says so and explains how to add more
[Claude Tag] Fixed thread requests to edit or delete a message Claude posted at the channel's top level being answered with a correction instead of reaching the session that posted it
[Claude Tag] Fixed **Connect** on Tool access requests under Admin settings > Review requests failing with "Authorization failed" or showing the requested access bundle as deleted

body.zh-TW: 你想同時處理多條開發分支又不想弄亂現有目錄？Codex 新增了實驗性的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）支援。⟦這恰似圖書館為大型研究計畫增設獨立自修室，研究員可以帶著資料副本到專用房間閉門作業，中途可以走出房間瀏覽各室進度，稍後也能重新進房接續未完的研究，完全不會佔用大廳的公共閱覽桌。⟧現在只要在啟動時加上 `--worktree` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/worktree` 指令，就能為全新或分支衍生出的工作階段建立彼此隔離的簽出目錄。建立之後，你還能隨心瀏覽所有存在的工作樹，並重新續接先前的工作進度。
body.en: Want to work on multiple branches simultaneously without cluttering your current directory? Codex now introduces experimental worktree support. ⟦This is like a library setting up private study rooms for major research projects, allowing researchers to work behind closed doors with copies of materials, step out to browse progress across rooms, and return later to resume unfinished work without occupying shared reading tables.⟧ Simply pass the `--worktree` flag at startup or enter the `/worktree` command in a conversation to create isolated checkout directories for new or forked sessions. Crucially, this interaction will not clear or affect your ongoing main draft in the input box, keeping both your thoughts and progress on track.

title.zh-TW: Vim 編輯新增 R 取代模式，支援復原與重複操作並改善退出鍵
title.en: Vim Editing Adds R Replace Mode with Undo, Dot-Repeat, and Reliable Escape Handling

body.zh-TW: 習慣 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在編輯草稿時手感將更加俐落。這次更新為 Vim 模式補上了經典的 `R` 取代模式，讓你可以直接覆蓋游標處的字元。進行文字替換時，你能按鍵復原（undo，回復到修改前的文字），也能利用小數點鍵重複執行上一次的取代動作。針對舊型終端機，更新也改善了 Escape 鍵的訊號處理，讓跳離編輯模式的操作更可靠，避免按鍵延遲或失靈。⟦此舉有如手寫打字機具備了即時覆蓋色帶，既能直接壓字修正錯別字，又能藉由倒退鍵復原上一步或連打重複印字，同時也把老舊按鍵卡榫徹底潤滑修好。⟧
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings will enjoy a snappier draft editing experience. This update brings the classic `R` replace mode to Vim mode, allowing you to overwrite characters directly under the cursor. During text replacement, you can undo changes and use the dot key to repeat your previous replacement action. For legacy terminals, the update improves Escape key handling, making exiting edit modes more reliable and avoiding key delays or failures. ⟦This is like a typewriter equipped with an instant correction ribbon that overwrites typos, allows backspacing to undo or repeating keystrokes, while fully lubricating worn-out mechanical key joints.⟧

items.original: Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆保留富文字格式，/copy 指令支援狀態與欄位擷取
title.en: Copying Responses Preserves Rich-Text Formatting as /copy Gains Status and Field Extraction

body.zh-TW: 將對話產生的程式碼或說明貼到其他文書軟體時，排版不再被打亂成純文字了。現在從 Codex 複製回覆內容，貼入支援富文字（rich-text，包含粗體、標題與程式碼區塊等排版樣式）的應用程式時，會完整保留原本的格式外觀。與此同時，命令列工具的 `/copy` 指令也迎來功能強化，除了複製回覆本身，現在還能單獨複製狀態輸出，或是擷取工作階段內的特定個別欄位。⟦一如專業相機輸出照片，既能直接沖洗出帶有完整色彩與層次細節的精緻相片，也可以單獨將相機當前的拍攝數據或特定參數獨立匯出備查。⟧這讓整理文件與分享除錯資訊變得更順暢。
body.en: Pasting generated code or explanations into other document apps will no longer scramble formatting into plain text. Copying responses from Codex into rich-text applications now fully preserves the original styling and appearance. Meanwhile, the command-line `/copy` command has been enhanced to copy status output or extract specific individual fields from a session in addition to the response itself. ⟦Just like a professional camera outputting photos, which can develop fine prints with full color and tonal detail, or independently export current shooting metadata and specific parameters for reference.⟧ This makes organizing documentation and sharing debugging information much smoother.

items.original: Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

title.zh-TW: 現有工作階段動態辨識外掛工具，升級回捲自動重新整理
title.en: Existing Sessions Dynamically Detect Plugin Tools and Refresh on Upgrades or Rollbacks

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊的工作階段正在進行，外部外掛有了變更也不需要關掉重開。⟦這如同工廠的工具旋轉吊架，在技師開工期間若由後勤人員掛上新零件或替換工具規格，技師不必停工重開電閘，轉身就能直接拿取最新到貨的工具與操作手冊。⟧既有的工作階段現在具備動態感知能力，能在不中斷執行的情況下，即刻辨識剛安裝好的外掛工具。當外掛在外部完成升級或執行版本回捲時，當前視窗會立即重新整理相應的技能。連同內部定義的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也會一併更新，確保所有自動化流程即時生效。
body.en: When your current session is running, you no longer need to restart it when external plugins change. ⟦This is like a factory rotating tool rack where logistics staff hang new parts or replace tool specifications while technicians work, allowing technicians to grab newly arrived tools and manuals without shutting down power or halting work.⟧ Existing sessions now feature dynamic detection to recognize newly installed plugin tools without interrupting execution. When plugins are upgraded or rolled back externally, the active window immediately refreshes corresponding skills. Internally defined hooks are updated as well, ensuring all automated workflows take effect immediately.

items.original: Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協調權杖更新與登入挑戰，舊版伺服器啟動入口退場
title.en: MCP Connections Coordinate Token Refreshes and Login Challenges as Legacy Entry Point Retires

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接外部服務時，授權憑證的維護現在更安全且井然有序。當多個工具連線需要更新 OAuth 授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）時，Codex 會統一協調這些連線的更新動作。若更新失敗，介面會主動跳出登入驗證挑戰提示，絕不自動重播先前已被拒絕的工具呼叫。此外，先前已被標記為棄用的 `codex mcp-server` 啟動入口也在本次更新中正式移除。⟦猶如園區更新外包廠商的門禁機制，廠商證件過期時由系統集中協調換證，換證失敗即引導人員臨櫃重新認證，絕不拿遭拒的舊卡重複硬刷閘門；同時管理處也正式封閉已張貼告示的舊側門。⟧
body.en: Maintaining authorization credentials when connecting to external services via MCP is now safer and more orderly. When multiple tool connections require OAuth token refreshes, Codex coordinates the refresh across those connections. If a refresh fails, the interface surfaces login challenges without automatically replaying previously rejected tool calls. In addition, the previously deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is officially removed in this release. ⟦This is like an office park updating contractor access control, where expired badges are renewed through centralized coordination, failed renewals direct personnel to service counters for re-verification without repeatedly swiping rejected cards at gates, and management seals off the deprecated side entrance.⟧

items.original:
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: 啟動流程阻擋未信任輔助程式，macOS 沙盒嚴防終端機注入
title.en: Startup Blocks Untrusted Workspace Helpers as macOS Sandbox Prevents Terminal Injection

body.zh-TW: 開啟陌生專案目錄或在蘋果電腦上執行終端機，資安防線在開工當下就已全面就位。現在 Codex 在啟動過程中，若尚未與當前工作區建立明確的信任關係，會主動避免執行任何由工作區控制的輔助程式，杜絕惡意腳本趁虛而入。與此同時，macOS 系統下的沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護層）也經過強化，能確實阻擋未經許可的終端機輸入注入攻擊。⟦這好似進入高度管制的實驗室，外部帶來的隨身器材在通過信任檢驗前一律禁止插電啟動，而隔離艙門的防護隔板也能阻擋外界未授權的按鈕信號干擾。⟧這讓你在檢視未知程式碼時能受到更周密的保護。
body.en: When opening unfamiliar project directories or running terminals on Mac computers, security defenses are active right from the start. During startup, Codex actively avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before establishing trust with the current workspace, preventing malicious scripts from taking advantage. Meanwhile, the macOS sandbox has been strengthened to block unauthorized terminal input injection attacks. ⟦This is like entering a high-security laboratory where personal equipment brought from outside cannot be powered on before trust verification, while containment barriers block unauthorized external button signals.⟧ This ensures thorough protection when inspecting unknown code.

items.original: Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)

title.zh-TW: 遠端續接與分支保留已存權限，新工作階段尊重預設模型
title.en: Remote Resume and Fork Preserve Saved Permissions While Fresh Sessions Follow Default Models

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端環境接續或分流既有進度時，設定與權限將維持一致。當你針對遠端工作階段執行續接（resume，接續先前中斷的進度）或分支操作時，先前已經儲存的授權與權限設定現在會完整延續，省去反覆確認授權的打擾。同時，全新開啟的工作階段以及衍生的分支，除非你在指令中明確指定其他模型，否則一律會嚴格遵守伺服器端配置的預設模型規格。⟦正如跨國企業指派主管遠端接管或分流專案小組，原有的門禁通行權限會自動跟隨繼承，而新立案的分支部門也會直接套用總部規範的標準設備，不必每次連線都重新簽呈。⟧此舉確保了跨端協同作業的權限延續性與環境規範。
body.en: Configurations and permissions remain consistent when resuming or branching progress in remote environments. When performing resume or fork operations on remote sessions, previously saved authorizations and permission settings are preserved, eliminating repetitive authorization prompts. Furthermore, fresh sessions and derived forks strictly respect server-configured default models unless you explicitly specify another model in your command. ⟦Just as a multinational enterprise assigns managers to take over or split project teams remotely, existing access permissions are automatically inherited, while newly chartered branch units adopt standard equipment prescribed by headquarters without requiring new approvals for each connection.⟧ This ensures permission continuity and environmental standards during remote collaboration.

items.original: Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)

title.zh-TW: 跨應用程式續接對話防衝突，提供唯讀逐字紀錄且保留草稿
title.en: Cross-App Conversation Resume Prevents Conflicts with Read-Only Transcripts and Draft Preservation

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續處理某個對話，但該對話正巧在另一個應用程式中開啟時，現在不必再擔心進度衝突了。⟦彷彿走進銀行閱覽保管箱資料，若另一位共同持有者正在櫃檯查閱正本，行員會先為你提供唯讀對照副本與等候重試號碼牌，並妥善看管你正在填寫的申請表格。⟧Codex 會在介面上顯示唯讀的對話轉錄（transcript，完整對話逐字紀錄），讓你能回顧過往脈絡，並附上重新嘗試的按鈕選項。與此同時，你當前輸入框中正在撰寫的文字草稿也會受到完整保護，不會被清空或覆蓋，方便你在另一端釋放鎖定後立刻接手。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about progress conflicts when resuming a conversation that happens to be open in another application. ⟦It is like visiting a bank vault to inspect documents where, if a co-owner is reviewing the original at the counter, the clerk provides a read-only reference copy and a retry ticket while safeguarding the application form you are filling out.⟧ Codex displays a read-only transcript in the interface so you can review past context, accompanied by a retry button option. Meanwhile, your ongoing text draft in the input box remains protected without being cleared or overwritten, allowing you to take over immediately once the lock is released on the other side.

items.original: Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留壓縮脈絡，遇新指令自動駁回失效授權
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Compaction Context and Reject Invalidated Authorizations

body.zh-TW: 面對需要反覆審核權限的操作流程，自動審查機制的判斷現在更加嚴謹周全。在對話歷程經歷壓縮（compaction，精簡長對話以節省記憶體的機制）後，自動核准審查機制能更完善地保留原本的授權脈絡，避免重要授權因紀錄濃縮而遺失。更重要的是，一旦使用者在後續給出了全新的指令或補充回答，只要先前的核准因此失效，審查機制就會果斷駁回該項核准，防止舊授權被錯誤套用到新情境。⟦類似於建築師審查工程變更單，即使過往會議紀錄經過摘要精簡，簽核依據依然完整留底；而只要業主中途變更了設計需求，先前簽核的舊工單就會立刻作廢重新評估。⟧
body.en: When dealing with workflows that require repeated permission reviews, automatic approval mechanisms are now more rigorous. Following conversation compaction, automatic approval reviews better preserve original authorization context, preventing critical authorizations from being lost due to history condensation. More importantly, once users provide fresh instructions or supplementary answers that invalidate earlier approvals, the review mechanism promptly rejects those approvals to prevent obsolete authorizations from being misapplied in new contexts. ⟦Similar to an architect reviewing engineering change orders, where approval records remain intact even after past meeting notes are summarized, but previously signed work orders are immediately invalidated for re-evaluation whenever the owner alters design requirements midway.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

entries: Improved resilience to transient model API errors: the agent now retries errors such as `503 Unavailable` for much longer with exponential backoff, so a brief service hiccup no longer aborts your session.

Improved sign-in and startup speed by reading your signed-in identity from the stored credential instead of making a network request on every launch and after browser consent; a failed identity lookup no longer prevents sign-in from completing, and the displayed plan tier no longer briefly disappears during startup.

Improved headless (`-p`) runs to exit promptly once the final answer is delivered: the CLI waits for running background tasks and scheduled timers to finish, bound by `--print-timeout`, and leaves daemon background tasks such as dev servers running instead of terminating them.

Improved failure reporting in headless (`-p`) runs: fatal errors now appear on stderr with a stable `error:` marker, a note is printed when the response may be truncated, and runs that previously ended silently with no output now explain why.
Improved headless (`-p`) turnaround by cutting up to 200 ms of idle latency per turn and skipping the model call that generated a conversation title no one would see.

Improved tool approval prompts to say exactly what you are approving — for example `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?` — with the command-editing shortcut offered only when a command is being approved, and a `Reason:` line explaining why approval is being requested when it is not obvious, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project.

Improved model selection auditability: the CLI log now records whenever a model name you specify resolves to a different model, such as alias resolution, `--effort` variant selection, or replacement of a deprecated saved model.

Changed what happens when `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn: the CLI now returns the partial output it has and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, instead of failing with a timeout error; interrupts such as Ctrl+C still exit non-zero.
Changed the default permission for fetching URLs from always allowed to asking first, so the agent now requests approval before reading a URL unless you have granted access.

Fixed plugin reinstalls keeping files that had been deleted from the source: installing a plugin now replaces its managed directory exactly, installing a plugin from its own installed directory is refused instead of corrupting it, and uninstalling a plugin no longer leaves its enabled/disabled entry behind in `config.json`.

Fixed MCP servers defined by plugins resolving relative or unset working directories against the wrong location; they now resolve against the plugin's own directory so plugin-bundled scripts run correctly.
Fixed a startup race where subagents could fail to find tools from MCP servers that were still initializing.
Fixed subagents sometimes appearing stuck in a running state after they had finished — especially in very large conversations — which also left queued when-idle messages undelivered until restart.
Fixed a memory leak where every finished terminal command kept internal state alive for the rest of the session; long sessions that run many commands now use significantly less memory.
Fixed headless (`-p`) runs stalling forever on implementation-plan approval that no one could give; non-interactive runs now proceed through plan review automatically.

Fixed sign-in failing with a project access error after switching from a business account with a selected project to a personal account; stale business project and license details are now fully cleared on personal sign-in.

title.zh-TW: 遇到 503 暫時錯誤自動長重試，工作階段不中斷
title.en: Automatic extended retries on temporary 503 errors keep sessions uninterrupted

body.zh-TW: 你正請 AI 執行冗長的多步驟任務，最怕遇到遠端模型伺服器短暫壅塞。⟦好似在熱門麵包店結帳時遇到刷卡機短暫斷線，店員不會立刻退回商品並將你請出店門，而是請你稍待片刻後再次感應，直到連線恢復。⟧ 以前只要碰上 `503 Unavailable` 這類短暫的模型介面錯誤，整個正在進行的工作階段（session，從啟動到結束的一整段對話歷程）就會被迫終止。現在代理人遇到這類暫時狀況，會透過指數退避（重試等待時間隨失敗次數拉長的做法）大幅延長重試期。即使服務發生短暫波動，也不會隨意中斷你的工作階段。
body.en: When asking AI to perform long multi-step tasks, the biggest worry is hitting brief congestion on remote model servers. ⟦Much like a card reader briefly disconnecting at a busy bakery checkout, where the clerk does not immediately return your items and show you out the door, but asks you to wait a moment and tap again until the connection recovers.⟧ Previously, whenever encountering a transient model API error like `503 Unavailable`, the entire ongoing session was forced to terminate. Now, when encountering such temporary situations, the agent significantly extends the retry period using exponential backoff (waiting longer between retries as failed attempts increase). Even during brief service fluctuations, your session will no longer be casually interrupted.

items.original: Improved resilience to transient model API errors: the agent now retries errors such as `503 Unavailable` for much longer with exponential backoff, so a brief service hiccup no longer aborts your session.

title.zh-TW: 本機憑證快讀登入身分，切換帳號清空企業舊資料
title.en: Local credentials speed up sign-in identity checks and account switching clears stale business data

body.zh-TW: 每次啟動工具或切換帳號，現在都能迅速就緒。以前每次開啟命令列或在瀏覽器完成授權，都要先送出一趟網路請求確認身分；若是查詢遇到問題，整個登入程序就會卡住中斷，啟動時顯示的方案等級也常常閃爍消失。現在改為直接從儲存的憑證（存放在本機的登入身分證明）讀取資料，查詢失敗不再阻礙登入完成，畫面上的方案等級更維持穩定顯示。若是你剛從選定專案的企業帳號切換至個人帳號，舊的企業專案與授權細節現在會被徹底清除，不再因為殘留過期資料而跳出專案存取錯誤。⟦這好比拿出皮夾裡已蓋章的會員卡直接通關，驗票員不必每次都打電話回總部查驗，換成一般訪客卡時也會順手收回貴賓通行證，不再拿舊通行條擋住入口。⟧
body.en: Launching the tool or switching accounts is now ready promptly every time. Previously, opening the CLI or completing browser authorization required sending a network request to verify your identity; if the lookup ran into issues, the entire sign-in process would freeze and halt, and the plan tier shown at startup often flickered and disappeared. Now, data is read directly from stored credentials (login identity proofs stored locally), so lookup failures no longer block sign-in completion, and the on-screen plan tier remains stably displayed. If you switch from a business account with a selected project to a personal account, old business project and license details are now thoroughly cleared, preventing project access errors caused by leftover stale data. ⟦This is like showing a stamped membership card directly from your wallet at the gate without ticket staff calling headquarters every time, and handing over a regular visitor pass while returning the VIP badge so outdated passes will not block the entrance.⟧

items.original:
Improved sign-in and startup speed by reading your signed-in identity from the stored credential instead of making a network request on every launch and after browser consent; a failed identity lookup no longer prevents sign-in from completing, and the displayed plan tier no longer briefly disappears during startup.
Fixed sign-in failing with a project access error after switching from a business account with a selected project to a personal account; stale business project and license details are now fully cleared on personal sign-in.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式自動化更順暢，及時退出且日誌回報清晰
title.en: Smoother headless automation with prompt exits and clear error reporting

body.zh-TW: 將指令串進自動化排程時，最講求乾淨俐落與明確回報。⟦宛如快遞物流車隊的夜間集運，貨件裝車完畢就立即發車，沿途留下明確標籤與簽收單，不因無人簽名而原地乾等。⟧ 啟用無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的非互動執行模式）搭配 `-p` 旗標時，現在送達最終答案便會迅速退出。背景任務與排程計時器受 `--print-timeout` 限制等待結束，但開發伺服器等常駐守護工作會持續運行而不被強制中止。每輪執行省下多達 200 ms 閒置延遲，並跳過生成無人查看的對話標題。遇到無人互動的實作計畫審查時會自動通過。若 `--print-timeout` 中途逾時，會回傳既有輸出並在 stderr 附帶警告成功退出，手動按 Ctrl+C 中斷則維持非零退出碼。嚴重錯誤在 stderr 加上穩定的 `error:` 標記，提示潛在截斷並解釋先前靜默結束的原因。
body.en: Chaining commands into automated workflows demands clean execution and explicit feedback. ⟦Much like a logistics delivery fleet consolidating cargo overnight, departing immediately once loading is complete and leaving clear labels and receipts along the way without idling on-site because no one is there to sign.⟧ When running in headless mode with the `-p` flag, the CLI now exits promptly once the final answer is delivered. Running background tasks and scheduled timers are waited on subject to `--print-timeout`, while persistent daemon tasks like development servers continue running without being forcefully terminated. Each turn cuts up to 200 ms of idle latency and skips generating conversation titles that nobody would see. Non-interactive implementation plan reviews now pass automatically. If `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn, it returns the partial output and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, while manual Ctrl+C interrupts still exit with a non-zero code. Fatal errors add a stable `error:` marker on stderr, noting potential truncation and explaining why previous runs ended silently.

items.original:
Improved headless (`-p`) runs to exit promptly once the final answer is delivered: the CLI waits for running background tasks and scheduled timers to finish, bound by `--print-timeout`, and leaves daemon background tasks such as dev servers running instead of terminating them.
Improved failure reporting in headless (`-p`) runs: fatal errors now appear on stderr with a stable `error:` marker, a note is printed when the response may be truncated, and runs that previously ended silently with no output now explain why.
Improved headless (`-p`) turnaround by cutting up to 200 ms of idle latency per turn and skipping the model call that generated a conversation title no one would see.
Changed what happens when `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn: the CLI now returns the partial output it has and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, instead of failing with a timeout error; interrupts such as Ctrl+C still exit non-zero.
Fixed headless (`-p`) runs stalling forever on implementation-plan approval that no one could give; non-interactive runs now proceed through plan review automatically.

title.zh-TW: 讀取網址改為預先詢問，工具審查提示說清緣由
title.en: URL fetching asks for permission first and tool approval prompts explain reasons clearly

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 代勞查資料或動用本機工具時，安全把關更加清晰。抓取網址的預設權限從一律允許改為先問過你，除非預先授權，否則讀取網址前都會請求同意。工具審核提示也迎來翻新，明確點出審核項目——例如詢問 `Run this command?`、`Allow access to this URL?` 還是 `Allow calling this tool?`。編輯命令的快捷鍵僅在審核命令時提供，避免介面混淆。當審核原因不明顯時，下方會附上一行 `Reason:` 說明緣由，例如觸發了掛鉤（hook，在特定事件發生時觸發的攔截小程式）標記，或是涉及其他專案的檔案。⟦這彷彿在大門加裝智慧訪視對講機，外人想進門必須先按鈴通報，螢幕上清楚顯示對方的來意與身分，還會註記警衛攔檢的理由，不再讓人盲目按下開門鈕。⟧
body.en: Security guardrails are much clearer when having AI fetch data or invoke local tools. The default permission for fetching URLs has changed from always allowed to asking first, requesting approval before reading a URL unless pre-authorized. Tool approval prompts have also been revamped to specify exactly what is being approved—such as asking `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?`. The shortcut for editing commands is only offered when approving a command, preventing interface confusion. When the reason for approval is not obvious, a `Reason:` line is attached below explaining why, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project. ⟦This is like installing a smart intercom at the front door: visitors must ring first, the screen clearly displays their identity and purpose, and notes any guard inspection reasons so you never press the door release blindly.⟧

items.original:
Improved tool approval prompts to say exactly what you are approving — for example `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?` — with the command-editing shortcut offered only when a command is being approved, and a `Reason:` line explaining why approval is being requested when it is not obvious, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project.
Changed the default permission for fetching URLs from always allowed to asking first, so the agent now requests approval before reading a URL unless you have granted access.

title.zh-TW: 模型名稱轉換留存日誌，稽核軌跡隨時可查
title.en: Model name resolutions are logged for traceable audit trails

body.zh-TW: 在終端機指定模型名稱時，背後的實際流向現在一清二楚。⟦如同在藥局憑處方箋領藥，當藥劑師因原廠藥缺貨或劑型調整而替換成同成分學名藥時，收據與藥袋上都會清楚加註替換紀錄與變更原因。⟧ 命令列工具增強了模型選擇的稽核能力。當你輸入的模型名稱在後台被解析對應到另一款模型時，日誌都會詳實記錄具體轉換過程。無論是輸入別名對應到正式名稱、透過 `--effort` 旗標切換到不同推理程度的變體，或是先前儲存的舊模型因下架廢棄而被替換，日誌中都有跡可循。這讓你不必猜測背後到底跑的是哪一個版本，隨時都能追溯實際運行的模型。
body.en: When specifying model names in the terminal, the actual underlying resolution is now crystal clear. ⟦Much like filling a prescription at a pharmacy where an out-of-stock brand-name drug is substituted with an equivalent generic, with the replacement record and rationale clearly noted on the receipt and label.⟧ The CLI tool has enhanced its auditability for model selection. Whenever a model name you specify resolves behind the scenes to a different model, the logs faithfully record the specific conversion process. Whether resolving an alias to an official name, switching to a different reasoning variant via the `--effort` flag, or replacing a deprecated saved model, everything leaves a clear trail in the logs. This removes any guesswork about which version is running behind the scenes, allowing you to trace the active model at any time.

items.original: Improved model selection auditability: the CLI log now records whenever a model name you specify resolves to a different model, such as alias resolution, `--effort` variant selection, or replacement of a deprecated saved model.

title.zh-TW: 外掛重裝乾淨覆蓋目錄，MCP 相對路徑基準修正
title.en: Plugin reinstalls cleanly replace directories and MCP relative paths resolve accurately

body.zh-TW: 管理擴充套件與隨附工具時，現在不再留下惱人的殘存檔案。過去重新安裝外掛時，來源端已經刪除的舊檔案仍會留在目錄裡；現在安裝會精確替換整個外掛管理目錄，且若嘗試從外掛自身的已安裝目錄再次執行安裝，會被直接拒絕以防目錄損壞。解除安裝外掛後，也不會在 `config.json` 中留下殘餘的啟用或停用項目。同時，外掛所定義的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器若使用相對路徑或未指定工作目錄，先前會依錯誤位置解析；現在一律以該外掛本身的目錄為基準進行解析，確保隨附腳本正常運行。⟦恰似替相機更換擴充鏡頭套組，換上新套件時會徹底移走舊鏡片，拆除時順便清除控制選單裡的舊按鍵，套組內的專用濾鏡也一律以該鏡頭接環為基準精準卡位。⟧
body.en: Managing plugins and bundled tools no longer leaves annoying leftover files behind. Previously, reinstalling a plugin left old files that were already deleted from the source inside the directory; now, installation replaces the managed plugin directory exactly, and attempting to install from the plugin's own installed directory is directly rejected to prevent corruption. Uninstalling a plugin also no longer leaves leftover enabled or disabled entries in `config.json`. Meanwhile, if MCP servers defined by plugins use relative paths or leave the working directory unset, they previously resolved against the wrong location; they now consistently resolve against the plugin's own directory, ensuring bundled scripts run properly. ⟦Just like swapping a camera lens kit: mounting a new set completely removes old glass, detaching it cleans up stale button mappings from the control menu, and dedicated kit filters align accurately against the lens mount.⟧

items.original:
Fixed plugin reinstalls keeping files that had been deleted from the source: installing a plugin now replaces its managed directory exactly, installing a plugin from its own installed directory is refused instead of corrupting it, and uninstalling a plugin no longer leaves its enabled/disabled entry behind in `config.json`.
Fixed MCP servers defined by plugins resolving relative or unset working directories against the wrong location; they now resolve against the plugin's own directory so plugin-bundled scripts run correctly.

title.zh-TW: 子代理啟動不再遺漏工具，任務結束即刻解鎖佇列
title.en: Subagents reliably discover tools at startup and release queued messages upon completion

body.zh-TW: 多工派發子代理處理複雜任務時，工具抓取與狀態切換更加可靠。先前在系統啟動時存在競爭問題，如果外部工具伺服器仍在初始化，子代理往往會撲空。現在 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器會確保初始化完成，讓子代理隨時能找到工具。此外，特別是在超長對話中，子代理在執行完畢後有時會卡在運行狀態；這不僅造成狀態誤判，還會讓原本排隊等候閒置時發送的訊息一路卡住，非得重啟程式才能送出。如今這兩項瑕疵都已修復，子代理在任務結束後會正確切換狀態並如期交付排隊訊息。⟦有如工廠調派實習助理進場作業，開工前一定等儀器暖機完畢才放行領取工具，任務交代完畢也會立即回報交班，不再假裝忙碌而讓後續排隊的派工單全部卡死在收發室。⟧
body.en: Dispatching subagents for complex multi-tasking now offers more reliable tool discovery and state transitions. Previously, a startup race condition meant subagents could fail to find tools if external tool servers were still initializing. Now, MCP servers ensure initialization finishes so subagents can always find their tools. Additionally, especially in very large conversations, subagents sometimes appeared stuck in a running state after finishing; this caused incorrect status reporting and left messages queued for idle delivery stuck until restarting the application. Both issues are now resolved, so subagents properly transition their state and deliver queued messages on schedule once tasks finish. ⟦Like assigning an intern assistant on the factory floor: they are only sent to fetch tools after equipment warms up, and they report shift handovers immediately upon finishing tasks rather than pretending to stay busy and stalling dispatch orders in the mailroom.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a startup race where subagents could fail to find tools from MCP servers that were still initializing.
Fixed subagents sometimes appearing stuck in a running state after they had finished — especially in very large conversations — which also left queued when-idle messages undelivered until restart.

title.zh-TW: 終端機命令及時釋放內部狀態，長工作階段記憶體大降
title.en: Terminal commands release internal state promptly to cut memory usage in long sessions

body.zh-TW: 長時間在同一個工作階段中連續敲入指令，不再面臨記憶體越吃越腫的窘境。以前工具內部存在記憶體流失（程式結束運算後未及時釋放資源的現象）缺陷。只要在終端機中執行過任何命令，該命令的內部狀態就會被保留在記憶體中，直到整個工作階段（session，從啟動到關閉的完整使用過程）結束為止。這導致使用者若是開啟長期會話並執行大量指令，記憶體用量就會一路飆升。這次修復徹底清除了執行完畢後的殘留狀態，讓執行許多指令的長工作階段大幅降低記憶體消耗。⟦就像廚房料理台每做完一道菜就立即隨手擦拭乾淨，不再將用過的空盤與鍋具一路堆到打烊，就算連續出餐一整天，工作檯面也始終保持輕盈俐落。⟧
body.en: Running continuous commands in the same session no longer leads to runaway memory bloat. Previously, the tool suffered from a memory leak where every executed terminal command retained its internal state in memory for the rest of the session. As a result, running many commands in extended sessions caused memory usage to surge continuously. This fix thoroughly clears residual state once commands finish, significantly reducing memory consumption in long sessions that run many commands. ⟦Much like wiping down a kitchen countertop immediately after each dish instead of piling up used plates and pots until closing time, keeping the workspace neat and uncluttered even during a full day of service.⟧

items.original: Fixed a memory leak where every finished terminal command kept internal state alive for the rest of the session; long sessions that run many commands now use significantly less memory.

entries: **Grok now appears in the report and the interactive dashboard.** The menu bar has carried a Grok quota card for a while and `loaders/grok_loader.py` could already produce per-call token detail, but there was no `adapters/grok.py`, so both `usage report` and the dashboard were blind to it. The adapter was added along with the four lookup tables that have to agree: the registry's detector list, the `AGENT_LOADERS` maps in `usage_cli` and `reporter`, and `AGENT_SHORT` / `AGENT_LABEL` in `ui/tables`.

**The report breaks tokens into four kinds and shows each tool's cache hit rate.** The headline "tokens burned" was one number summing four different things; locally, 93.8% of a 2,565,454,499-token period was `cache_read` and only 0.7% was output the model actually generated, so the total said nothing. `UsageEntry` has always carried all four fields and `loaders/disk_cache_common.py` serialized all four — `reporter` was dropping them when it built the summary, so no cache and no schema version had to change. Cache hit rate is `cache_read / (input + cache_creation + cache_read)`; output is excluded because it is generated, not sent in. A high rate is the healthy end — old context reused at roughly a tenth of the price instead of re-sent at full rate — and the copy in all five languages is written to keep it from being read as "most of my tokens are wasted repeats."

**"One-pass rate" is now a section of its own, third from the top.** Whether the AI finished without you stepping in is a measure with no pre-LLM equivalent; the data was already computed and already drawn, but it sat in a small card inside "usage habits" in section 11, where most people never scrolled. It is now a full section placed after Insights and before Tools, and the model rows use the report's existing rank-line layout sorted by pass rate rather than by turns — the question the section answers is which model needs the least going back over, not which one is used most. No new i18n keys were required.

**The AI roundtable can pick Codex's Astra model.** `gpt-6-astra` is Codex's new default, but the roundtable's model allowlist hard-coded the three 5.6 variants. Pricing and the report needed no change: LiteLLM's table already carries real prices in all four of its fields, and the report's color assignment matches on the `gpt` prefix.

**"Cost burned" is now "API equivalent."** The label presented a figure multiplied out from list prices as money actually spent, which is misleading for subscription users whose marginal cost is zero. Renamed in all five languages; the Traditional Chinese-only NTD conversion went with it, since that ran an assumed figure through an exchange rate a second time. The number itself stays — API users still need it. The two headline cards never shared a denominator: "tokens burned" counts every agent, while "API equivalent" can only count models with a published price, so a subtitle now explains the gap, and only when unpriced tokens actually exist.

**Token composition is a ranked list instead of a stacked bar.** With one category at 93.8%, the other three collapsed into invisible slivers, the in-bar percentage labels piled up into `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` at the left edge, and the legend's swatches had no size styling at all. A stacked bar is the wrong chart once a single category passes ninety percent, and the four are not peers anyway — input, cache write and cache read are all context sent in, output is generated. Each category now gets its own row with its own columns, and the bar's 2% minimum width keeps a 0.7% share visible. Per-tool cache hit rates use the same layout, sorted by rate, so the weakest tool is the last row rather than something you have to hunt for.

**The report's data rows are filled bars, with columns that line up across every section.** Four separate problems: the two row systems (`.rank-line` and `.tool-row`) used different track widths and gaps, so numbers sat at different x positions in different sections; the share bar was a child of `.name` and capped by the name column, so it drew to about half the row and stopped; every section nested a section frame, a card frame and a row frame; and two sections used the shared layout with no column headers. The tools section had no bar element at all and now has one, with each tool's color keyed on its agent id rather than its sort position — `by_agent` is ordered by tokens, so a palette indexed by position would repaint every tool whenever two swapped places.

**The weekly burn section lost its daily line chart.** It had no scale and no values, did not match the "weekly" heading it sat under, and could not be read for anything actionable. The rows below it, carrying week number, value and week-over-week change, are unchanged.
**The top KPI row no longer repeats the one-pass rate.** Five cards laid out badly in a two-column grid, and the full section below already carries the per-model detail.

**The report says which span it is comparing against.** "vs. last month" and "vs. last week" became a single "vs. previous period," and the annual block is now "last 53 weeks" with the week count supplied by `WrappedReportData.weeks` from `_YEAR_WEEKS`, so the copy follows the constant if it ever changes.

**The quota warning fits inside the panels.** The red "running out" line was `white-space: nowrap` and needed 320–470px, but the panels' text box is 304–320px and the cards are `overflow: hidden` — deliberate retro chrome, not removable — so the sentence was cut off. Measured across 13 panels × 5 languages: Japanese lost 81–150px, and only three panels' English fit. The wording is now shorter with the same meaning. The World Cup panel gets an even shorter variant that omits the reset time, since its head-to-head layout leaves each side only 151px.

**The year ledger is never silently discarded.** `_read_year_ledger()` had four paths that returned an empty ledger, the worst being a `schema_version` mismatch: anyone changing a ledger field and bumping the version would have quietly zeroed every user's accumulated history, with no backup to recover from. This file exists precisely so that history survives after the raw logs rotate away, so clearing it defeats the thing it is for. Measured during development: one version bump took the local heatmap from 119 days to 36. A mismatched version now logs a warning and parses day by day anyway — `_year_day_from_json` already tolerates missing fields — and only a genuinely unreadable or structurally wrong file is moved into `~/.usage/quarantine/` before returning empty, matching what the disk cache already does.

**A git worktree whose main repo is bare no longer splits one project into two.** `resolve_project_name()` resolved the worktree back to its main path and took the basename, so the project name carried a `.git` suffix. `adapters/claude.py` parses paths without calling git and reported `obsidian00`, while the other three loaders went through `project_resolver` and reported `obsidian00.git`; locally that was 5997 entries against 3732, and the report listed one project twice, at 21.70% and 10.80%. The same bug sat in three layers: the resolver now strips a trailing `.git`, Codex's shard cache went from schema 4 to 5 so the 28 shards holding the old name are re-parsed, and the year ledger — which cannot be invalidated by a version bump without losing the only copy of that history — folds `X.git` back into `X` at read time instead.

**Token units no longer skip a tier when they round up.** `_fmt_tokens` picked the tier from the raw value and rounded afterwards without re-checking, so 999,950 printed as `1000.0K` and 999,950,000 as `1000.0M`.

**A type error in the token composition tests.** `data["summary"]` and the elements of `data["by_agent"]` are TypedDicts, so mypy rejects a loop variable used as a key; the two assertions now go through an `Any` intermediate. The lines came from the composition work and were not caught earlier because that batch had not been pushed yet.

title.zh-TW: Grok 登上用量報表與互動儀表板，四張對照表同步補齊
title.en: Grok arrives in usage reports and the interactive dashboard with four synchronized lookup tables

body.zh-TW: 平時習慣呼叫 Grok 協作的開發者，現在執行 `usage report` 或切換至互動儀表板時，終於能將它的用量一併納入統計。⟦這好比商場服務台早早掛出新專櫃的會員卡，樓層指南與各收銀機名冊卻全漏記，消費者看全館總表時始終找不到它；把各處對照表補齊後才完整歸隊。⟧先前 macOS 選單列雖有 Grok 的額度卡，讀取器 `loaders/grok_loader.py` 也能吐出逐次呼叫的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）明細，但轉接層缺少 `adapters/grok.py`，導致終端機報表與儀表板對它視而不見。這次除了補上轉接器，也同步了四張必須一致的對照表：註冊表的偵測清單、指令列與報表產生器的 `AGENT_LOADERS`，以及表格介面的 `AGENT_SHORT` 與 `AGENT_LABEL`。
body.en: Developers who regularly collaborate with Grok can now finally include its usage in statistics when running `usage report` or switching to the interactive dashboard. ⟦This is like a mall information desk displaying membership cards for a new boutique while the floor directory and register rosters omit it entirely, leaving shoppers unable to find it on the mall-wide directory until lookup tables everywhere are completed.⟧ While the macOS menu bar previously had a Grok quota card and the loader `loaders/grok_loader.py` could produce per-call token details, the adapter layer lacked `adapters/grok.py`, leaving the terminal report and dashboard blind to it. In addition to adding the adapter, this update synchronizes the four lookup tables that must agree: the registry's detector list, `AGENT_LOADERS` in the CLI and report generator, and `AGENT_SHORT` and `AGENT_LABEL` in the table UI.

items.original: **Grok now appears in the report and the interactive dashboard.** The menu bar has carried a Grok quota card for a while and `loaders/grok_loader.py` could already produce per-call token detail, but there was no `adapters/grok.py`, so both `usage report` and the dashboard were blind to it. The adapter was added along with the four lookup tables that have to agree: the registry's detector list, the `AGENT_LOADERS` maps in `usage_cli` and `reporter`, and `AGENT_SHORT` / `AGENT_LABEL` in `ui/tables`.

title.zh-TW: 報表細分四類 token 並顯示快取命中率，釐清真實消耗
title.en: Reports split tokens into four categories and display cache hit rates to clarify real consumption

body.zh-TW: 想掌握 AI 的實際消耗，過去報表頂部的「燒掉 Tokens」只把四種不同性質的數字加總成單一數值，根本看不出關鍵細節。⟦這好比水電帳單只印出一筆總度數，卻把洗澡水、澆花水與管線循環水全混在一起，讓人無法判斷用水習慣是否健康。⟧本機測試某期 2,565,454,499 個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）裡，高達 93.8% 是讀取快取的舊資料。快取就是把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接取用；模型真正生成的輸出只佔 0.7%，單看總額毫無意義。現在報表正式拆分為輸入、快取寫入、快取讀取與輸出四類，並計算各工具的快取命中率。算式以快取讀取除以三種輸入脈絡總額，排除掉生成出的輸出。高命中率代表舊脈絡以約十分之一的單價重複取用，五種語言的文案也明確引導此數值象徵體質良好而非無效重複。底層一直都記錄著這四個欄位，先前僅是報表彙整時丟棄，因此不必清理快取或升級資料格式。
body.en: To understand actual AI consumption, the headline "tokens burned" at the top of previous reports summed four distinct numbers into a single total, obscuring key details. ⟦This is like a water bill that only prints a single total usage while lumping shower water, garden water, and recirculated pipe water together, making it impossible to judge whether consumption habits are healthy.⟧ In local testing across a period of 2,565,454,499 tokens, as much as 93.8% was cache read while only 0.7% was output the model actually generated, rendering the raw total meaningless. The report now formally breaks down usage into input, cache write, cache read, and output, while calculating cache hit rates for each tool. The formula divides cache read by the sum of the three input contexts, excluding the generated output. A high hit rate indicates that old context is reused at roughly one-tenth the unit price, and the copy across all five languages explicitly frames this metric as a sign of healthy efficiency rather than wasteful repetition. The underlying layer has always recorded all four fields and previous versions merely discarded them during report aggregation, so no cache clearing or data format upgrade is required.
